messages:
Asha: Okay team, hypothetical quick poll: if the company had an unofficial theme song for the next all-hands, what should it be? Be honest. :musical_note:
Tom: "Walking on Sunshine" 
Viv: "Eye of the Tiger" (for dramatic slide transitions) :muscle:
Renee: "September" by Earth, Wind & Fire for pure joy :disco:
Asha: Love all of these. @party-bot can you run a tiny poll? 
party-bot: Poll created: "All-Hands Theme Song" — Options: Walking on Sunshine / Eye of the Tiger / September / Other
Tom: Vote cast: Walking on Sunshine :sun_with_face:
Viv: Vote cast: Eye of the Tiger :tiger:
Renee: Vote cast: September :sparkles:
Asha: Voted Other ("The Safety Dance" because it would force awkward choreography) :man_dancing:
Tom: If Walking on Sunshine wins I will choreograph an intro skip for the execs. Low-effort, high-joy. 
Viv: If Eye of the Tiger wins I demand a dramatic laser pointer for the first slide. 
Renee: September requires confetti. I'm already ordering biodegradable confetti. 
Asha: Whoever picked Other owes a 10-second demo of the dance in the lounge. 
party-bot: Reminder set: all-hands theme voting closes tomorrow at noon. 
Tom: Also leaving this here: petition to have a tiny theme-song-epilogue in the podcat newsletter. 
Viv: I'm secretly lobbying for a mashup. 
Renee: We should make a tiny playlist. I'll start it and share in #random. 
Asha: Great. Thanks team — may the best banger win. Thread will close when confetti budget is confirmed.
